easyPrerequisites: Phantom Steed must be exiled by Changeling Berserker, and Yannik must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Yannik for its mana cost.
When Yannik enters, it exiles Changeling Berserker until Yannik leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Yannik's ETB.
When Changeling Berserker leaves the battlefield, Phantom Steed is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Phantom Steed enters, it exiles Yannik until Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Phantom Steed's ETB.
When Yannik leaves the battlefield, Changeling Berserker is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Changeling Berserker enters, it exiles Phantom Steed until Changeling Berserker leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Changeling Berserker's ETB.
When Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield, Yannik is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
